budget_items.topic: FY21 General Fund unassigned fund balance
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The auditors reported the unassigned fund balance at $7.2 million, about 16% of budget, up from $1.6 million in 2013.
budget_items.quote: that left you with a general fund unassigned fund balance of $7.2 million dollars which is about 16% of your budget

budget_items.what_was_recorded: General stabilization totaled $2.5 million; zoning stabilization $230,000; vehicle equipment stabilization $1.2 million, about a $250,000 increase.
budget_items.quote: your general stabilization fund totaled $2.5 million. that has steadily increased since 2013 when it was a million dollars

budget_items.topic: FY21 general fund results and free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: General fund balance rose $872,000 on a $966,000 revenue surplus; expenditures came in $1.4 million under budget; $858,000 of Free Cash was used to balance FY21 and encumbrances fell $522,000.
budget_items.quote: the general fund balance increased by $872,000 and that was mainly due to a revenue surplus of $966,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer fund balance $1.6 million (up about $227,000); solid waste recycling $134,000 (up about $123,000); cable television enterprise fund $857,000.
budget_items.quote: your enterprise funds, sewer fund balance totaled $1.6 million, about a $227,000 increase from the prior year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town contributed $111,000 to the OPEB trust; trust balance $589,000 at year end; net OPEB liability $65.6 million, up about $9.8 million.
budget_items.quote: next is the opeb liability; the town contributed an additional $111,000 to the opeb trust fund.

budget_items.topic: Net pension liability (Worcester Regional Retirement System)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town's liability associated with the Worcester Regional Retirement System was stated, but the figure is cut off at the page break.
budget_items.quote: your liability associated with that is $19.8

budget_items.what_was_recorded: $610,000 of short-term debt; no new long-term governmental debt issued; $37.6 million governmental and $4.5 million sewer long-term debt outstanding.
budget_items.quote: you had $37.6 million outstanding and for your sewer activities you had $4.5 million outstanding.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town expended $1.9 million in federal funds, including $338,000 for school lunch and $702,000 for the Coronavirus relief grant; the single-audit threshold is $750,000.
budget_items.quote: the town expended $1.9 million, of that $338,000 was related to school lunch, $702,000 related to the coronavirus refund grant.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Old outstanding checks balance fell from $61,000 at end of 2020 to $9,000.
budget_items.quote: the balance at the end of 2020 was $61,000, now down to $9,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ambulance receivables totaled $622,000 at year end, of which $552,000 was over 180 days old.
budget_items.quote: the ambulance receivables balance at the end of the year totaled $622,000 and $552,000 of that was over 180 days old.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Balances of $50.00 or less with proof of hardship are written off; Fire Chief may recommend waivers up to $250.00.
budget_items.quote: amounts due of $50.00 or less to which patient returns the bill proving hardship with supporting documentation will be written off.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $939,717.33.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $939,717.33.
